_meta.purpose: THIS estate's coordinate (C5 2a, 2026-09-03). The one root file that says which estate this checkout IS. Later: the module block (C5 3a).
_meta.rule: An id is a COORDINATE, not a label — renaming the place does not rename the estateId. `handle` is the public-safe human name tools may print; `id` is what records, KV prefixes and grants carry. Never derive one from the other.

modules._rule: C5 3a (Q1 → unit B, the named bundle). A module is a NAMED BUNDLE whose members are declared in momlib.MODULES — never a per-domain switch. States: on · on-minimal (ON for domains) · off · declared-absent (OFF for domains; `declared-absent` says the family was never built here, `off` says it exists and is switched off — C7). A module MISSING from this block is OFF and a check-domains finding, never a silent default. Fernwood: everything on. `weather` is a NON-DOMAIN module (a renderer switch — the weather tile and card), declared because the strip reads it.
